objective: Implement deterministic point-in-time Volume Profile analytics on governed actual trade prints, including price buckets, POC and deterministic value-area bounds, without converting quote/tick proxies into trade volume or introducing trading authority.
scope: Define governed Volume Profile policy and deterministic bucket convention
Build price-bucket volume distribution from actual TradePrint inputs only
Carry provider, venue, source-kind and coverage scope from P09-B
Enforce ordered and contiguous source sequence for the reference profile
Compute deterministic Point of Control with explicit tie-break
Compute deterministic Value Area High/Low for an explicit target coverage
Fail closed on excessive sparse ranges, mixed streams, invalid bin geometry or misleading Forex coverage
out_of_scope: Order Book, spread, depth or imbalance implementation (P09-D)
Funding, Open Interest, liquidation or crowding models (P09-F)
Signal fusion, calibrated trade probability, Risk approval or broker/exchange execution
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: open PRs 0, active task none, active lock none
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P09 Volume Profile source
Profile input accepts governed TradePrint only
Sequence gaps and reversed event time fail closed
Bucket assignment is deterministic for decimal prices
POC is maximum-volume bucket with lowest-price tie-break
Value area expands from POC by adjacent bucket volume with deterministic lower-price tie-break
Value-area target is satisfied or fails closed
Excessive sparse bucket ranges fail closed
Spot-FX global/consolidated trade-profile claims remain forbidden through P09-B validation
Profile contracts expose no order/recommendation authority
P09-C evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No broker/exchange execution adapter is imported
No credential or network access is required
No quote/tick proxy is transformed into a synthetic volume profile
rollback: Revert P09-C profile module, policy, tests, evidence/CI wiring and active-state reconciliation. P09-A/B remain canonical and no production/trading state changes.
definition_of_done: POC and Value Area invariants enforced
Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
